question: Lost in the Middle 效应的量化边界：在 RoPE 位置编码下，当查询位置 Q_pos 远离上下文中心 C_pos 时，注意力权重衰减系数 α = exp(-λ * |Q_pos - C_pos| / max_len)，其中 λ≈0.001 [待核验]；Map-Territory 策略通过将关键信息聚合至 Map（位置 0-2k），使有效距离缩短，从而将 α 提升至 >0.8，确保召回率不随原文长度线性下降

sources.snippet: Long-context language models often neglect information in the middle of the input, a phenomenon known as "lost-in-the-middle". Part of this gap may stem from the long-range decay of rotary position embedding (RoPE), which weakens the positional signal between distant tokens.
